    noncomputable def ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.CEP.Faithful.RelWordFiber {X : Type u} {H : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] (intTensorFiber : CorrEndBimod H H → RelFiberCarrier H → RelFiberCarrier H) (E0 : X → CorrEndBimod H H) :
    List X → RelFiberCarrier H

    Right-recursive reduced-word relative fiber over End H. The empty word is the vacuum fiber; a nonempty word tensors the head correspondence over End H with the tail fiber.
